evals.prompt: Use $dealership-campaign-creative-director to assess this regular real-photo dealership overlay. Give a ship/revise/reject decision, the exact retained visual contract, and a concise acceptance record. Run or apply the bundled deterministic validator; do not invent anything not present in the fixture.
evals.expected_output: A ship decision for the photographic candidate, preserving the exact people, truck, dealership spelling, single WELCOME HOME headline, name-free pixels, and integrated premium overlay.
expectations: The output approves the candidate rather than requesting an unnecessary transformation.
The output preserves the same people, vehicle, and real photographed setting.
The output keeps exactly WELCOME HOME and Northstar Ford while keeping personal names out of pixels.
The deterministic validation result is a pass with no hard or craft failures.

evals.prompt: Use $dealership-campaign-creative-director to assess the explicitly requested Fun transformation in the fixture. Return a ship/revise/reject decision and explain why the transformation is energetic without replacing the real customers or vehicle. Apply the deterministic validator.
evals.expected_output: A ship decision that recognizes the supplied genuine logo, exact KEYS DAY headline, requested playful transformation, preserved identities, and campaign-grade execution.
expectations: The output treats the transformation as authorized only because the fixture explicitly requests Fun mode.
The output confirms the same people and vehicle remain recognizable.
The output distinguishes the supplied genuine logo from a generated mark.
The deterministic validation result is a pass.

evals.prompt: Use $dealership-campaign-creative-director to compare the two Depth Pop fixtures. Identify which candidate is shippable, reject the pasted-on treatment, and give the smallest correction needed. Apply the deterministic validator to both.
evals.expected_output: A comparison that rejects the floating flat treatment and approves only the candidate whose 3D elements share the photographed scene's perspective, light, shadows, occlusion, and depth planes.
expectations: The output rejects depth-pop-floating-fail.json for missing environmental integration.
The correction calls for perspective, light, shadows, occlusion, and scene-plane integration rather than more decorative 3D objects.
The validator results match the fixtures' expected pass values.

evals.prompt: Use $dealership-campaign-creative-director to audit the unsafe candidate fixture. State whether it can ship, identify every hard rejection, and provide a safe regeneration contract. Apply the deterministic validator and do not repeat the unsafe customer name as proposed public copy.
evals.expected_output: A fail-closed rejection covering the wrong personal name, incorrect dealer spelling, fabricated logo, prompt leak, extra headline, and social UI, followed by a name-free exact-brand correction contract.
expectations: The output rejects the candidate and never calls it acceptable with a warning.
The output identifies personal-name text, wrong dealership spelling, fabricated logo, prompt leakage, and social UI as hard failures.
The safe correction uses only WELCOME HOME and exact Northstar Ford text with no customer name or invented mark.
The deterministic validation result fails for the expected hard reasons.
